blocks.text: DAKAR, Senegal—The Philippines shifts its medal hunt to gymnastics Saturday as Hillarion Palles III opens his campaign at the Youth Olympic Games here, with athletics, cycling and windsurfing also set to get underway. Palles will compete in the men’s individual all-around qualification at the Dakar Exhibition Center in Diamniadio. Tchelzy Maayo follows on Sunday in […]...
